meta.title: The Desert Treasure
meta.subtitle: Rumors speak of a hidden fortune buried deep within Goldwind Desert. Many have searched. None have returned with proof.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: X The Desert Intersection
scenes.narrative:
The wind howls softly as grains of sand slide across the cracked road beneath your boots. Ahead of you lies an intersection, long abandoned, marked only by a broken wooden sign barely hanging on.

To the left, the road stretches toward towering dunes. Straight ahead, the land dips slightly, and faint heat waves ripple in the distance. To the right, jagged rocks rise like teeth from the sand.

Somewhere out there lies the treasure.

choices.text: Go straight into the heat haze
Take the rocky path to the right

scenes.title: ~ The Endless Dunes
scenes.narrative:
The dunes stretch endlessly, each one taller than the last. Your legs grow heavy as the sand shifts beneath you.

After what feels like hours, you spot a small structure half-buried in sand. A rusted ladder leads up its side.

scenes.title: . Above the Sands
scenes.narrative:
You climb the ladder carefully. At the top, you find a flat rooftop with an open hatch leading inside.

From here, you can see far across the desert. In the distance, a faint shimmer reveals what looks like an oasis... or maybe something else.

scenes.title: @ The Forgotten Outpost
scenes.narrative:
Inside the building, dust covers everything. Old crates, broken furniture, and faded markings line the walls.

On a table sits a worn map. Across the room is a sealed metal door, slightly ajar.

scenes.title: # The Map
scenes.narrative:
The map is detailed, far more than expected. It marks a hidden chamber beneath the desert, accessible only through an entrance near a false oasis.

You now know where to go.

scenes.title: $ Supplies
scenes.narrative:
You dig through the crates and find old but usable supplies—water, tools, and a flare gun.

This might come in handy.

scenes.title: & The Guardian
scenes.narrative:
The door creaks open.

Inside, something moves. A twisted, mechanical creature—part machine, part bone—lurks in the shadows.

It notices you instantly.

choices.text: Use flare gun (if you have supplies)

scenes.title: * Escape
scenes.narrative:
The flare explodes in light, blinding the creature. It recoils, screeching.

You escape the building, heart racing. You now know this place is connected to something bigger.

scenes.title: + The Mirage
scenes.narrative:
You walk toward the shimmering oasis. The closer you get, the more it flickers.

When you arrive, it vanishes completely.

But beneath the sand, you notice a hidden hatch.

scenes.title: ^ The Hidden Chamber
scenes.narrative:
You descend into darkness.

Below the desert lies a vast underground chamber lit by glowing crystals. At its center stands a massive chest.

scenes.title: ! The Balcony Vault
scenes.narrative:
You drop into the building from above and land on a hidden balcony.

Below you sits a massive chest untouched by time.

scenes.title: Lost to the Desert
scenes.narrative:
You keep walking.

The sun rises higher. Your water runs out. The dunes never end.

Eventually, you collapse into the sand, becoming just another lost explorer.

scenes.title: Too Slow
scenes.narrative:
You try to run, but the creature is faster.

It lunges, and everything goes dark.

scenes.title: The Trap
scenes.narrative:
As you step closer, the ground shifts.

The chamber collapses, sealing you inside forever.

The treasure was never meant to be taken.

scenes.title: The Treasure of Goldwind
scenes.narrative:
You open the chest.

Inside is more wealth than you could have imagined—gold, gems, artifacts from a lost civilization.

You have found the treasure.

Your name will be remembered.

scenes.title: The Rocky Cliffs
scenes.narrative:
The path is steep and dangerous. Loose rocks shift beneath your feet.

Halfway up, you find a skeleton clutching a journal.

scenes.title: The Fall
scenes.narrative:
A rock slips.

You lose your footing and fall into the canyon below.

The desert claims another.
